tasks.label: dev: shared
tasks.command: pnpm --filter @aar/shared build; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; pnpm --filter @aar/shared dev

background.endsPattern: Found 0 errors. Watching for file changes.

tasks.label: dev: api
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; if (Test-Path .env) { Get-Content .env | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^\s*([^#][^=]+)=(.*)$') { $name = $matches[1].Trim(); $value = $matches[2].Trim(); [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name, $value, 'Process') } } }; pnpm --filter @aar/api dev
